Axion's Build-section additions in v0.6 (review-before-apply diff screen, in-app live preview refresh, command output in chat with a status chip)
follow the **workflow ideas** described in this project's public README (chat with a coding agent, real Linux commands, review diffs, preview web
apps on the phone without root). I read only the README; **no source code was copied or translated** — ChangeGate.kt, ReviewChanges.kt,
CommandStatus.kt and HtmlPreview.kt are Axion's own code written against Axion's existing Build/Agent architecture.
